query:
SELECT
                m.id,
                COALESCE(m.parent_type, 'channel') AS "parent_type!",
                COALESCE(m.parent_id, m.channel_id::text) AS "parent_id!",
                COALESCE(m.thread_id, m.id) AS "thread_id!"
            FROM comms_messages m
            WHERE m.id = $1 AND m.deleted_at IS NULL
